text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ

translations.asad: WHEN THE SUN is shrouded in darkness,
translations.sahih: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

translations.asad: and when the stars lose their light,
translations.sahih: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

translations.asad: and when the mountains are made to vanish,
translations.sahih: And when the mountains are removed

translations.asad: and when she-camels big with young, about to give birth, are left untended,
translations.sahih: And when full-term she-camels are neglected

translations.asad: and when all beasts are gathered together,
translations.sahih: And when the wild beasts are gathered

translations.asad: and when the seas boil over,
translations.sahih: And when the seas are filled with flame

translations.asad: and when all human beings are coupled [with their deeds],
translations.sahih: And when the souls are paired

translations.asad: and when the girl-child that was buried alive is made to ask
translations.sahih: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

translations.asad: for what crime she had been slain,
translations.sahih: For what sin she was killed

translations.asad: and when the scrolls [of men's deeds] are unfolded,
translations.sahih: And when the pages are made public

translations.asad: and when heaven is laid bare,
translations.sahih: And when the sky is stripped away

translations.asad: and when the blazing fire [of hell] is kindled bright,
translations.sahih: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

translations.asad: and when paradise is brought into view:
translations.sahih: And when Paradise is brought near,

translations.asad: [on that Day] every human being will come to know what he has prepared [for himself].
translations.sahih: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].

translations.asad: BUT NAY! I call to witness the revolving stars,
translations.sahih: So I swear by the retreating stars -

translations.asad: the planets that run their course and set,
translations.sahih: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -

translations.asad: and the night as it darkly falls,
translations.sahih: And by the night as it closes in

translations.asad: and the morn as it softly breathes:
translations.sahih: And by the dawn when it breathes

translations.asad: behold, this [divine writ] is indeed the [inspired] word of a noble apostle,
translations.sahih: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger

text.arabic: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍۢ

translations.asad: with strength endowed, secure with Him who in almightiness is enthroned
translations.sahih: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

translations.asad: [the word] of one to be heeded, and worthy of trust!
translations.sahih: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

translations.asad: For, this fellow-man of yours is not a madman:
translations.sahih: And your companion is not [at all] mad.

translations.asad: he truly beheld [the angel - beheld] him on the clear horizon;
translations.sahih: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.

translations.asad: and he is not one to begrudge others the knowledge [of whatever has been revealed to him] out of that which is beyond the reach of human Perception.
translations.sahih: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.

translations.asad: Nor is this [message] the word of any satanic force accursed.
translations.sahih: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

translations.asad: Whither, then, will you go?
translations.sahih: So where are you going?

translations.asad: This [message] is no less than a reminder to all mankind –
translations.sahih: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

translations.asad: to everyone of you who wills to walk a straight way.
translations.sahih: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

text.arabic: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ

translations.asad: But you cannot will it unless God, the Sustainer of all the worlds, wills [to show you that way].
translations.sahih: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
